arguments.text: We propose a novel framework for citation parsing. We trained a BiLSTM with AdamW on the PubMed corpus. Our results indicate that the model achieves an accuracy of 0.91 and an F1 of 87.5%. We assume that references are well formed. A limitation of this study is that only English papers (café, naïve, α-helix) were used. Samples were heated to 300 K under 2.5 GPa. The energy is $E = mc^2$.
